title: Optimal Aggregation of LLM and PRM Signals for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Peng Kuang、Yanli Wang、Xiaoyu Han、Yaowenqi Liu、Kaidi Xu、Haohan Wang
best_for_zh: 研究推理预算分配的读者。
one_line: Optimal Aggregation of LLM and PRM Signals for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
当过程奖励模型分数与生成器频率产生相关错误时，它可能损害选择。
why: It measures a concrete decision about additional inference computation.
inclusion_reason: It makes test-time compute allocation, efficiency, or scaling behavior explicit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A PRM and generator can have different error patterns, so top-score selection and raw majority voting both discard useful evidence.

The paper asks what makes extra inference computation productive rather than merely longer. A credible comparison must distinguish an improved allocation or selection rule from a result produced by silently increasing the budget.

过程奖励模型和生成器可能具有不同错误模式，因此最高分选择和原始多数投票都会丢弃有用证据。

本文研究什么会让额外推理计算变得有效，而不只是让输出更长。可信比较必须把更好的分配或选择规则，与悄然增加预算造成的结果区分开来。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Optimal LLM–PRM aggregation derives pair-specific calibrated weighted voting from generator reliability and PRM score likelihoods.

It treats test-time scaling as a decision process: the useful question is where an extra sample, token, score, or decoder step changes evidence for the final answer.

最优语言模型—过程奖励聚合从生成器可靠性和过程奖励分数似然推导模型对特定的校准加权投票。

它把测试时扩展视为决策过程：有用的问题是额外样本、token、分数或解码步骤在哪里改变了最终答案的证据。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method derives pair-specific calibrated weighted voting from generator reliability and PRM score likelihoods.

Reproduction requires the prompt, intermediate traces, every allocation or selection decision, final answer, and the full cost of generation and auxiliary computation; otherwise a matched-budget baseline is impossible.

该方法从生成器可靠性和过程奖励分数似然推导模型对特定的校准加权投票。

复现需要提示、中间轨迹、每个分配或选择决定、最终答案，以及生成和辅助计算的完整成本；否则无法建立预算匹配的基线。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official study reports that five LLMs and seven PRMs show reported efficiency gains over vanilla weighted voting.

This supports the proposed mechanism in its tested models and tasks, not a guarantee that another deployment, model family, or serving stack will obtain the same quality–cost curve.

官方研究报告，五个语言模型和七个过程奖励模型显示相对原始加权投票的报告效率收益。

这支持在测试模型和任务中的所提机制，但不保证另一个部署、模型家族或服务技术栈会获得同样的质量—成本曲线。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Compared with a fixed reasoning recipe, the work makes a particular test-time allocation or accounting decision explicit.

Its contribution is therefore more than a larger nominal budget: it identifies how additional computation is converted into evidence, selection, or speed.

与固定推理配方相比，该工作让一种特定的测试时分配或核算决策变得明确。

因此，它的贡献不只是更大的名义预算：它识别额外计算如何被转化为证据、选择或速度。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The conclusion depends on the model, decoding configuration, task distribution, and cost definition. All auxiliary work—drafting, scoring, calibration, or preprocessing—must be counted before transferring an efficiency claim, and aggregate accuracy can hide slow or unreliable tail cases.
结论依赖模型、解码配置、任务分布和成本定义。在迁移效率主张前，必须计入草稿、评分、校准或预处理等全部辅助工作，聚合准确率也可能掩盖缓慢或不可靠的尾部案例。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it to compare a concrete allocation policy with a genuinely matched-budget baseline. Log realized work per input, intermediate evidence, final correctness, and average and tail latency; it is most useful when a system must choose how to spend a finite inference allowance.
可用它将具体分配策略与真正预算匹配的基线比较。应记录每个输入的实际工作、中间证据、最终正确性、平均和尾部时延；当系统必须决定如何花费有限推理额度时，它最有用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Trace every added computation unit to the decision it changes. Separate longer generation from selection, calibration, verification, and acceleration effects, then check that the comparison counts all of them; one isolated accuracy point is weaker evidence than a complete quality–cost curve.
应把每个新增计算单位追踪到它改变的决策。要分开更长生成与选择、校准、验证和加速的影响，再检查比较是否计入全部成本；一个孤立准确率点弱于完整质量—成本曲线。

title: Citation
引用
html: 《最优语言模型—过程奖励聚合》。ICLR 2026。
